note.en: A goby under 2 cm that lives at the base of patch reefs and under coral boulders, recorded in tide pools at Punta Piuta and at Isla Uvita off Limón in 1967 to 1969.
note.es: Un gobio de menos de 2 cm que vive en la base de parches de arrecife y bajo bloques de coral, registrado en pozas de marea de Punta Piuta y en Isla Uvita frente a Limón en 1967 a 1969.

sources.t: OBIS and GBIF records, Gandoca to Limón (Costa Rican university tide-pool and reef surveys 1962 to 1979, museum specimens)
